{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Darkfire''''' was the name of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] captained by [[Flandon Sweeg]] in [[Rogar Farnoster]]'s ''[[The Slug Named Grendel]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[The Slug Named Grendel|work]] the ''Darkfire'' appeared in bears strong similarities with the 1851 novel [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moby_Dick Moby Dick], authored by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herman_Melville Herman Melville]. Such similarities includes the formatting of the first line and the narrative of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ishmael_(Moby-Dick) protagonist] who has joined a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pequod_(Moby-Dick) crew] upon a quest led by a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Captain_Ahab captain] of questionable morals after a sizable [[Limb/Legends|limbless]], [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-destroying [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moby_Dick_(whale) creature] [[Color/Legends|colored]] white.
